title: Cleaning for Grandma Rosa
setting: Grandma Rosa's bright living room with a wooden floor.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

characters.name: Lily
characters.look: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots)

characters.name: Grandma Rosa
characters.look: Grandma Rosa (an old woman with white hair in a bun, a purple shawl and a walking stick)

sentences.en: At two p.m., Ben and Lily clean after lunch.
sentences.zh: 下午两点，吃完午饭后，本和莉莉开始打扫。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) pick up a broom and a cloth in a bright living room in the afternoon sun; empty lunch plates sit on a side table.
sentences.draw_note: Shows the children starting to clean after lunch; the exact time can't be shown.

sentences.en: Grandma Rosa collects cups, and she has sixty.
sentences.zh: 罗莎奶奶收集杯子，她有六十个。
sentences.scene_prompt: Grandma Rosa (an old woman with white hair in a bun, a purple shawl and a walking stick) proudly shows a tall shelf full of many small colourful cups.
sentences.draw_note: Shows a shelf of many cups; the exact number is not shown.

sentences.en: At the beginning, Ben works very fast.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) rushes around the living room with a duster in each hand.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben working very fast; 'at the beginning' can't be shown.

sentences.en: He moves the low table to clean the floor.
sentences.zh: 他挪开矮桌子来打扫地板。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) pushes a low coffee table aside on a wooden floor.

sentences.en: He makes a mistake and drops a dirty cup.
sentences.zh: 他一不小心，把一个脏杯子掉了下去。
sentences.scene_prompt: A dirty cup slips from the hand of Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and falls.

sentences.en: The cup falls right on his left foot.
sentences.zh: 杯子正好砸在他的左脚上。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) hops on one leg holding his left foot, a cup on the floor.

sentences.en: Lily sends him to sit down for a second.
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) points to the sofa and Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) sits down with a sigh.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Lily sending Ben to the sofa; 'for a second' can't be shown.

sentences.en: "That is the third cup today!" she laughs.
sentences.zh: “这是今天的第三个杯子了！”她笑着说。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) laughs and holds up a cup next to a tray with two other broken cups, while Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) smiles shyly on the sofa and Grandma Rosa (an old woman with white hair in a bun, a purple shawl and a walking stick) laughs in her armchair.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Lily laughing with broken cups; the spoken words and 'third' can only be guessed.
